build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: The player character accelerates over time while grounded, building speed continuously. Momentum is preserved through jumps and wall-jumps. Hard collisions or landings reduce speed. The physics feel weighty and momentum-driven. Score 0 if movement is instant-velocity with no acceleration.

Wall-jumping is present and preserves horizontal momentum — jumping off a wall while moving fast launches the player further than a standing wall-jump. The mechanic rewards speed maintenance. Score 0 if no wall-jump exists.

Gold pieces are collectible throughout levels. A key item must be collected to unlock the exit door. The exit door only opens when the key is held. Score 0 if no collectibles or key-gate mechanic exists.

A countdown timer per level creates urgency. Failing the timer or falling into a void restarts the level instantly. The timer is visible and ticking during gameplay. Score 0 if no timer or time pressure exists.

Level completion awards a rating based on time remaining and gold collected. The rating (stars, grade, or score) is displayed on the level-complete screen and on the level-select grid. Score 0 if no rating system exists.
At least 20 distinct levels are present across multiple labs, each with unique platform layouts that test momentum mechanics differently. Score 0 if fewer than 10 levels exist.

At least 4 distinct environmental elements are introduced across labs (ice surfaces, conveyor belts, bounce pads, gravity zones, wind tunnels, moving walls, etc.) each changing how momentum behaves. Score 0 if only basic platforms exist.
Multiple labs (at least 4) organize levels into themed groups, each introducing a new environmental element. Labs unlock sequentially. Score 0 if no lab/world organization exists.

Gold placement rewards momentum-preserving routes — some gold is only reachable by maintaining high speed through complex sequences. Optional gold creates risk/reward decisions between safe paths and fast paths. Score 0 if gold is only on obvious paths.

A level-select grid shows all levels organized by lab with completion status, rating, and best time visible per level. An overall stats screen shows total gold and completion percentage. Score 0 if no level select or stats exist.
A styled title screen shows the game name and a level-select grid organized by lab with thematic art. Score 0 if the game starts directly in gameplay or uses raw default UI.
The game flow connects title -> level select -> gameplay -> level complete -> back to select without restarting. Score 0 if transitions are missing.
During gameplay, the timer, gold count, key status, and speed indicator are visible in a clear HUD. Score 0 if no HUD is displayed.
Readability at 1280x720 is strong: player, platforms, environmental elements, gold, key, and exit are all clearly distinguishable. Score 0 if elements blend together.

The art direction is coherent across title, levels, UI, and environmental elements — a consistent minimalist laboratory aesthetic with clean lines and unified palette. Score 0 if mostly default UI or mismatched placeholders dominate. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.

Level environments use real sprite or tile art for platforms, walls, environmental elements, and the player — not plain ColorRect fills. Different labs have visually distinct themes. Score 0 if environments are uniform color fills.

HUD and UI chrome: timer, gold counter, level select grid, rating display, and completion screens use styled themed widgets — not raw unstyled HTML 引擎 defaults. Score 0 if primary UI elements are obviously unstyled.

Animation and feedback: the player has a speed-dependent run animation or trail, gold collection sparkles, wall-jumps produce impact particles, the timer pulses when low, and level completion has a celebratory effect. Score 0 if all state changes snap silently.
